items.title: Marty Morell interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 24, 2017
items.q: Some quote from Lester Young, “Just tickety-tick for Lester, don’t be dropping no bombs” or something.

ctx.x: Where she didn’t want to go.
Some quote from Lester Young, “Just tickety-tick for Lester, don’t be dropping no bombs” or something.

Yeah. I guess I got a little too adventurous. But she was really sweet. She sent me some sheet music, some tunes that I liked, and that’s fine. Sometimes it just doesn’t work out. And it didn’t really bother me. Because I was playing with Steve Kuhn and Ron Carter.
